entries.note: The label was printed; a waybill printed again shows it once per print.
A courier collected the parcel. The step names the courier, which the adapter does not keep.
Taken into an office's depot, after a courier's collection or over the counter. The step names the office.
Loaded on a line from one office to the next. The step names the office and the line.
Unloaded from a line at the next office, which the step names.
Grouped with other parcels at the office the step names.
Taken out of its group at the office the step names, ahead of delivery.
With a courier for delivery. The step names the courier, which the adapter does not keep.
Delivered. The step names whoever signed, which the adapter does not keep.
